labs.title: Reduce SharePoint oversharing before Copilot rollout
labs.summary: Find broad sharing in the SharePoint admin center, request owner review, restrict HR site access, limit Copilot discovery, and harden sharing defaults.
labs.scenario: Contoso is preparing Microsoft 365 Copilot. Before rollout, use the **simulated SharePoint admin center** to find overshared SharePoint sites, initiate a site access review for **HR-Internal**, restrict that site to the HR security group, turn on Restricted Content Discovery for the site, and set safer sharing defaults. Everything is simulated; no real tenant is changed.
learningObjectives: Run SharePoint Data access governance activity reports for EEEU and sharing links
Initiate a site access review for an overshared site
Compare Restricted site access with Restricted Content Discovery
Set site and organization sharing defaults for least privilege
prerequisites: Know that Copilot honors existing Microsoft 365 permissions and policies

steps.title: Run the EEEU activity report
steps.instruction: In **Reports** > **Data access governance**, open **Shared with 'Everyone except external users'** and select **Run**.
steps.hint: The report is an activity report on the Data access governance landing page.
steps.explanation: The EEEU report identifies sites where content is shared broadly with all internal users.

rules.description: The EEEU activity report is ready
rules.failureFeedback: Open the Shared with 'Everyone except external users' report and select Run.

steps.title: Run the sharing links activity report
steps.instruction: Return to **Data access governance**, open **Sharing links**, and select **Run** to view sites with recent sharing links.
steps.hint: The Sharing links report is another activity report under Data access governance.
steps.explanation: Sharing links reports show where users created broad or external links, which can become Copilot discovery risks.

rules.description: The sharing links report is ready
rules.failureFeedback: Open the Sharing links report and select Run.

steps.title: Ask the HR site owner to review oversharing
steps.instruction: On the **Shared with 'Everyone except external users'** report, use **Initiate site access review** for **HR-Internal**. Do not delete the site or remove its owner.
steps.hint: Use the row action for HR-Internal in the EEEU report.
steps.explanation: A site access review delegates item-level cleanup to the site owner, who is best positioned to validate legitimate access.

rules.description: A site access review was initiated for HR-Internal
rules.failureFeedback: Initiate the site access review for HR-Internal from the EEEU report.

steps.title: Restrict access and discovery for HR-Internal
steps.instruction: Go to **Sites** > **Active sites**, open **HR-Internal**, then on **Settings** turn on **Restrict SharePoint site access to only users in specified groups**, choose **HR Security Group**, turn on **Restrict content from Microsoft Copilot**, enter a justification, and select **Save**.
steps.hint: Restricted site access changes effective access. Restricted Content Discovery limits org-wide search and Copilot discovery but does not change permissions.
steps.explanation: Use Restricted site access when the site must only be usable by a control group; use Restricted Content Discovery as a temporary discoverability control while owners right-size permissions.

rules.description: HR-Internal is restricted to the HR Security Group and RCD is on
rules.failureFeedback: Open HR-Internal settings, enable restricted site access for HR Security Group, and enable Restrict content from Microsoft Copilot.

steps.title: Turn off external file sharing for HR-Internal
steps.instruction: On the **HR-Internal** site details, open **Sharing** and set **External file sharing** to **Only people in your organization**, then select **Save**.
steps.hint: This setting prevents new external file sharing from this site.
steps.explanation: Site-level sharing limits are important for sensitive sites because they prevent site owners from creating broader links than the business allows.

rules.failureFeedback: Set HR-Internal External file sharing to Only people in your organization.

steps.title: Set conservative organization link defaults
steps.instruction: Open **Policies** > **Sharing**. Under **File and folder links**, set **Default link type** to **Specific people** and select **Save**.
steps.hint: Specific people links require named recipients and are less likely to be forwarded broadly.
steps.explanation: A default link type of Specific people reduces future oversharing by making least-privilege sharing the normal path.

rules.description: The default link type is Specific people
rules.failureFeedback: Set Default link type to Specific people in Policies > Sharing.

steps.title: Verify the oversharing cleanup
steps.instruction: Return to **Active sites** and **Policies > Sharing** to verify **HR-Internal** no longer exposes EEEU broadly, external file sharing is internal-only, and default links are **Specific people**.
steps.hint: The final rules check the site and organization sharing defaults together.
steps.explanation: A final verification step connects the report findings to actual access-control changes, which is the core Copilot readiness lesson.

rules.description: HR-Internal and organization sharing defaults are cleaned up
rules.failureFeedback: Finish the HR site sharing change and organization default link settings.

labs.solution:
1. Open **Reports** > **Data access governance** > **Shared with 'Everyone except external users'** and select **Run**.
2. Return to **Data access governance**, open **Sharing links**, and select **Run**.
3. In the EEEU report, on **HR-Internal**, choose **Initiate site access review**. Do not delete the site or remove its owner.
4. Open **Sites** > **Active sites** > **HR-Internal** > **Settings**. Turn on **Restrict SharePoint site access to only users in specified groups**, choose **HR Security Group**, turn on **Restrict content from Microsoft Copilot**, enter a justification, and select **Save**. Restricted site access changes effective access; Restricted Content Discovery limits organization-wide search and Copilot discovery but does not change permissions.
5. Open **Sharing** for **HR-Internal**, set **External file sharing** to **Only people in your organization**, and select **Save**.
6. Open **Policies** > **Sharing**, set **Default link type** to **Specific people**, and select **Save**.
7. Final verification: confirm **HR-Internal** is no longer broadly exposed and organization sharing defaults use **Specific people** links.
